title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-134-25二模

items.zh: 不要因为一次失败的尝试,就放弃你的目标。
items.en: Never give up your goals simply because of a single failed attempt.

items.zh: 这位知名作家推荐的书广受追捧,现已售罄。
items.en: The book recommended by the famous writer is so sought-after that it has sold out.

items.zh: 这座北方冰城面对突如其来的大批游客,一时无所适从。
items.en: With a large number of visitors\ suddenly flooding in, the northern ice city was at a loss.

items.zh: 当你知道这些交通工具和旅行线路背后的故事,你一定会惊叹人类一直以来是多么富有冒险精神。
items.en: After learning the stories behind these modes of transport and travel routes, you will surely be amazed at how adventurous humans have always been.
